arguments.summary: P17 has shown high technical competence, appropriate authority, and a strong track record of accurate guidance. The focus of the investigation should be on the pgbouncer connection pool refresh and the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Begin by examining the pgbouncer logs and configuration related to the connection pool refresh. Simultaneously, export the failed_jobs table for analysis and to identify the root cause of the failing jobs.
